name: Tube Free
description:
PROMPT COPY HERE:*

*Project Title: "TubeFree - The Ultimate Offline YouTube Alternative"*

I want to build a revolutionary mobile application named "TubeFree" that competes directly with YouTube but works 100% OFFLINE without requiring an internet connection.

*Core Concept:*
Create a modern, next-generation entertainment super-app that contains ALL features of YouTube but uses advanced offline technology. The app should feel like YouTube Premium x Netflix x TikTok combined.

*Key Features Required:*

*1. Content Categories:*
- Movies (Hollywood, Bollywood, Lollywood)
- Dramas (Pakistani, Turkish, Korean)
- Cartoons & Anime for kids
- Islamic Content: Naat, Bayan, Tilawat, Hamd
- Music, Vlogs, Education, Comedy, Sports
- User-generated content like YouTube

*2. Core YouTube-like Features (Must Have):*
- Home Feed with personalized recommendations
- Shorts / Reels style vertical videos
- Search with voice search and smart filters
- Like, Dislike, Comment, Subscribe, Share
- Watch History, Watch Later, Playlists, Liked Videos
- Channel creation and video upload system
- Notifications and Subscription feed
- Dark / Light Mode

*3. The Main USP - OFFLINE TECHNOLOGY (Explain this):*
Implement a hybrid offline-first architecture using cutting-edge tech:
- *Pre-loaded Content Library:* The app comes with a massive compressed encrypted library of 10,000+ hours of content stored locally on the device using advanced compression (H.265 / AV1 codec) to save storage.
- *Smart P2P Sync Technology:* When users come near each other or connect to a special Wi-Fi hotspot (like at a shop), the app automatically syncs and exchanges new videos via Wi-Fi Direct / Bluetooth / P2P mesh network without using internet data. (Similar to ShareIt / Xender tech but automated).
- *Periodic Super-Update:* Users can go to a local franchise / shop / partner point and update their entire content library with 1-click via super-fast local transfer.
- *AI Smart Storage:* App automatically deletes unwatched old videos and keeps trending / user-preference videos using on-device AI to save phone storage.

*4. Design & Tech Stack:*
- UI/UX: Modern, clean, minimal like YouTube 2026. Fluid animations, Material You 3 design.
- Tech: Use Flutter for cross-platform (Android & iOS), Firebase for local database (Hive / Isar), FFmpeg for video compression.
- Player: Custom powerful offline video player with 4K support, playback speed control, picture-in-picture, background play, quality selector.
- Monetization: AdMob offline ads (pre-loaded ads), Premium subscription for ad-free.
- Performance: Super fast, works on low-end Android phones, low battery usage.

*5. Extra Modern Features:*
- AI Recommendation Engine (On-Device AI - No internet needed)
- AI Auto-Dubbing: English movies auto-dubbed to Urdu/Hindi offline
- Kids Mode with Parental Control
- Download-less Offline - Everything is already offline

*Goal:* Build the APK file. The app should look premium, professional, and ready to compete with YouTube in Pakistan, India, and other countries where internet is expensive. Use dummy video data for now.

Build me the full source code, UI, and project structure step-by-step
